source: Production s2gm2025 z9 tile set: the finished/pilots-1/z9-full tree of the sat render workdir (eox1-work/scripts/sat/work/s2gm2025), enumerated 2026-11-21 from the sha256 migration manifest of that tree. Four staging copies of the set agree at 9,296 tiles. Live spot probes from the Pi: 6 in-set tiles returned 200; 4 union-only staging leftovers, 4 absent neighbors, and 1 out-of-set tile returned 404.
